access.crumb: Organization · accounts, roles, invitations, delegation, support access
access.title: Users and roles
access.description: Who can sign in and what each person may do. A role is a set of permissions; a person with several roles has every permission of all of them.

required.name: Enter a display name.
required.confirm_email: Type the email address to confirm.
required.display_name: Enter the name shown on the website.

create.title: New user
create.intro: The account starts without a role: give it roles on the next page. A mail asking to confirm the address goes to the new email.
create.name: Display name
create.passwordHint: 12 to 128 characters. Leave empty to let the person set it through a password-reset mail, or set a first password later.
create.done: User created. Give them roles below.

user.notFound: No user has this id. The account may have been deleted.
user.name: Display name

status.title: Status
status.activeHint: Can sign in and use the API.
status.disableNow: They are signed out everywhere and their access tokens stop working at once.
status.disableKeep: The account, its roles and its data stay; they cannot sign in until enabled again.
status.disableUndo: You can enable the account again at any time.
status.disabled: Account disabled; they were signed out everywhere.

roles.title: Roles
roles.about: Saving replaces every role of this person. Changes apply on their next request.
roles.everything: Every permission, including ones added later.

delete.title: Delete {who}?
delete.goesNow: The account and its sign-in methods are deleted now.
delete.goesLater: Data other modules keep for this person is deleted shortly after.
delete.noUndo: This cannot be undone. To only stop them from signing in, disable the account instead.
delete.meta: Removes the account and everything it owns. Needs every permission the person has.

units.about: Roles given at a store, warehouse or region. A role reaches the units below as far as its depth allows. The roles above apply at the root (the whole customer).
units.none: Not assigned at any other unit.
units.title: Roles at a unit
units.intro: Tick the roles this person has at the unit. Untick all to remove them from it.
units.hint: You can only give roles whose permissions you hold at that unit; the built-in admin role works only at the root.

admin.title: Administrator actions
admin.about: Actions on someone else's account. Check who is asking before using them.

reset.title: Send a password-reset mail
reset.meta: The person chooses a new password from the link (valid 30 minutes). Administrators cannot replace an existing password.
reset.sent: If the account is active, a reset mail is on its way to {email}.

password.meta: Only for an account created without a password.
password.title: First password for {who}
password.intro: Works only when the account has no password yet. To change an existing password, send a password-reset mail.
password.done: Password set; they can sign in with it.

sessions.meta: Ends every session of this person on every device.
sessions.title: Sign {who} out everywhere?
sessions.now: Every session ends; each device must sign in again.
sessions.tokens: An access token already issued keeps working until it expires (15 minutes by default).
sessions.keepOut: To keep them out for good, disable the account instead.
sessions.done: {count, plural, =0 {They had no session.} one {Ended # session.} other {Ended # sessions.}}

mfa.meta: For a person who lost the device with their authenticator app.
mfa.title: Turn off two-step sign-in for {who}?
mfa.effect: They sign in with the password alone, then can set up a new device.
mfa.check: Make sure the request really comes from them: anyone who knows the password can then sign in.

passkeys.about: Passkeys of this person. Remove one when they lose the device; they then sign in with the password and can add a new passkey. Their password and sessions stay as they are.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.effectOne: This passkey stops working at once. Their password, other passkeys and sessions stay as they are.
passkeys.effectAll: Every passkey stops working at once. They sign in with the password and can add new passkeys.
passkeys.check: Make sure the request really comes from them: removing a passkey is how an account is recovered.
passkeys.forbidden: You cannot see the passkeys of this person: they have permissions you lack.

admin.mailOff: This server does not send mail yet (no SMTP server set): reset and verification mails are only written to files on the server, and nobody receives them.

roles.count: {count, plural, =0 {No permission} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}

role.name: Name

role.findHint: Find by name or what it allows…

role.readOnly: You can see this role but not change it (needs auth.roles.manage).

delete.title: Delete the role {name}?

role.requiresMfaHint: The permissions of this role work only for accounts with an authenticator app or a passkey. Others keep their account and are asked to turn it on.

invitations.sent: Invitation sent; follow it in this list.
invitations.name: Name (optional)
invitations.depth: How far each permission reaches is set by the role, not here. You can only invite with roles whose permissions you hold at that unit.
invitations.title: Invitations

invitations.resent: Sent again to {email}; the old link stopped working.
invitations.revokeLink: The link in the mail stops working at once.
invitations.revokeAgain: To invite them later, send a new invitation.

delegations.created: Delegated; the event is recorded at both customers.
delegations.expiresHint: Empty: no end date. Ends at the end of that day (UTC).
delegations.reasonHint: 10 to 500 characters; both customers see it in their audit log.

delegations.audit: Each time your staff enter a child customer through a delegation, the event is recorded there and copied back to you, so both sides can look it up.
delegations.revokeNow: Sessions opened through it lose their permissions on the next request.
delegations.revokeAudit: The revocation is recorded at both customers.
delegations.heading: Delegation
delegations.childIdHint: The child customer's ID, as the platform operator gives it. It must be a customer below yours.

public.isPublicHint: Off: the unit disappears from the list of stores.

verify.description: Confirm that this address belongs to you.

reasons.unknown: This link is not valid: it may be cut off, or a newer mail replaced it. Sign in and send a new verification mail from My account.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter the email of your account; we send a link to choose a new password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.noToken: This link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.
reset.done: Your password was changed and you were signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.
reset.description: The link from the mail works once, for 30 minutes.

reasons.expired: This link has expired: it works for 30 minutes. Ask for a new one.
reasons.used: This link was already used. If you did not change your password with it, ask for a new link.
reasons.unknown: This link is not valid: it may be cut off, or a newer mail replaced it. Ask for a new one.

notMe.title: Did someone else change your email?
notMe.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the mail again.
notMe.description: The mail you got says the email of your account was changed. If you did not do it, report it here.
notMe.effects: Reporting locks the account against whoever changed it: it is signed out everywhere, its password, API keys, passkeys and two-step sign-in are removed. When your old address is still free, it is given back and you get a mail to choose a new password.
notMe.submit: It was not me — lock my account
notMe.done: Whoever changed your email can no longer get in. If your old address was free, a mail to choose a new password is on its way to it; otherwise ask an administrator to give the account back to you.

reasons.expired: This link has expired: it works for 7 days after the change. If you still cannot get into your account, ask an administrator.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.description: Campaigns go only to people who confirmed their sign-up; every mail has a one-click unsubscribe link. Opens and clicks are not tracked.
newsletter.noTrackingAbout: Tracking pixels are unreliable and touch personal data, so the module does not measure them. The numbers here are real: sent, failed and skipped.

statusAbout.scheduled: Sending starts at the scheduled time. Changing it moves it back to draft.
statusAbout.sending: Mails go out in batches at the server's rate. Pause stops after the current batch.

newsletter.noLists: No list yet. Create one, then offer it on your website's sign-up form.

sumAbout.confirmed: Get the campaigns of their lists

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Stock by variant and warehouse, adjustments with a reason, transfers, stock counts, lots and serial numbers, and receiving goods from suppliers.

levels.title: Stock by variant and warehouse
levels.about: One row per variant in one warehouse. “On hand” is what is physically there; “reserved” is promised to orders not yet shipped; “available” is what can still be sold. Below minimum means available is above 0 but not over the minimum; at 0 it counts as out of stock.
levels.ledgerNote: “On hand” equals the sum of this row’s ledger. To change it, record a movement (adjustment, transfer, receipt) — never edit the number.
levels.valueAbout: On hand × weighted average cost of each warehouse; the cost is recalculated at every receipt.
levels.oversellStrong: Never sells more than there is.
levels.oversell: An order reserves stock with one conditional decrease of “available”, so many buyers at once cannot exceed what is left. A reservation that is not paid in time is released by a job.

moves.about: Append-only: every receipt, sale, transfer, adjustment, count and lot expiry is one row. Nothing is edited or deleted; a mistake is corrected with a reverse row and a reason. These are stock records kept for at least 10 years.
moves.title: Latest movements
moves.appendOnly: A ledger row is never edited or deleted. If it was wrong, record a reverse adjustment with a reason.
moves.quickAbout: For damaged, lost or found goods, or a wrong receipt. The reason is required so accounting and auditors understand why stock changed.
moves.who: Reading the ledger needs inventory.read; adjusting needs inventory.adjust at that warehouse. Staff of one store cannot see or change another store’s stock.

adjust.title: Adjust stock
adjust.intro: Records one ledger row. Positive adds, negative removes. It cannot be changed afterwards.
adjust.done: Adjustment recorded; stock and low-stock alerts update at once
adjust.replayed: This adjustment was already recorded; nothing changed twice
adjust.serialsHint: Separated by spaces; as many as the quantity.

reorder.title: Change the minimum stock
reorder.intro: When available drops to or below this level, one low-stock alert is sent.

transfer.title: Create a transfer
transfer.intro: A new transfer is a draft and does not move stock yet. Click “Ship” when the goods leave the source.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.about: Draft → in transit → partly or fully received → closed. Shipping removes stock from the source; receiving adds it at the destination.
transfers.shipIncoming: The goods show as “incoming” at {to} until received.
transfers.shippedDone: Shipped: stock removed at the source; incoming at the destination
transfers.cancelPoint: The draft is cancelled; stock does not change. This cannot be undone.
transfers.received: Received: stock added at the destination (transfer_in)
transfers.receivePartIntro: Enter what arrived; the rest stays in transit.
transfers.receivedPart: Recorded what arrived; the rest is still in transit
transfers.closePoint: Nothing more will be received on this transfer.
transfers.closeShort: Anything missing must be recorded as an adjustment with a reason at the source.

notes.draft: A draft does not move stock. Click “Ship” when the goods leave.
notes.in_transit: Goods in transit belong to no warehouse’s sellable stock; at the destination they show as “incoming”.
notes.partially_received: Something is missing: receive the rest when it arrives, or close and record an adjustment with a reason.
notes.received: Everything arrived. Close the transfer to finish.

count.title: Open a stock count
count.intro: Count a whole warehouse or one area. Each line records the stock at the moment it is counted.
count.scopeHint: Whole warehouse, or a shelf / category.

counts.whileSellingStrong: Count while the store keeps selling.
counts.whileSelling: The system records the stock at the moment you count each line. Difference = counted − stock at count time, then added to current stock; sales between counting and applying are not miscounted.
counts.title: Stock counts
counts.missingReason: {count, plural, one {# line without a reason} other {# lines without a reason}}
counts.needReasons: Lines with a difference need a reason before applying (inventory.reason_required).
counts.applyNote: Applying records a “count” movement of exactly the difference on current stock; it never overwrites stock with the counted number.
counts.applyPoint: Each line with a difference becomes a ledger row with its reason.
counts.applyFinal: Ledger rows cannot be removed afterwards.
counts.applied: Stock count applied: differences recorded with their reasons
counts.cancelPoint: The counted numbers are kept on the cancelled count; stock does not change.

lots.title: Lots and expiry dates
lots.about: Turned on per product. Shipping picks the lot that expires first. Expired lots are removed from stock every day so expired goods are not sold.
lots.writeOffPoint: {count} units are removed from stock with the reason “expired”.
lots.writeOffFinal: The ledger keeps the row as a record; it cannot be undone.
lots.legal: No general rule requires “first expired, first out”; not selling expired goods falls under product quality and food safety law. A specialist should confirm for each kind of goods.

serials.title: Serial numbers
serials.about: For goods with a per-unit warranty. Each serial can be sold once; shipping must scan all serials of the line.
serials.restockPoint: The unit passed inspection; it returns to sellable stock at {where} (return +1).
serials.writeOffPoint: The unit can no longer be sold. This cannot be undone.

purchasing.receivedAll: Receipt created for the rest: stock added, cost recalculated, ledger job queued
purchasing.closePoint: Nothing more will be received; the undelivered part leaves “incoming”.
purchasing.cancelPoint: The order is cancelled and leaves “incoming”. This cannot be undone.
purchasing.receiptsAbout: Each receipt adds stock, recalculates the weighted average cost and queues a ledger job: debit inventory, credit payable to the supplier.
purchasing.ledgerNote: Ledger jobs run again safely: the ledger refuses a second entry with the same reference (inventory.receipt + receipt id).

finance.crumb: Bếp Mộc · books of the customer root and of Chợ Bếp Mộc · accounting currency VND
finance.title: Accounting
finance.description: Append-only double-entry ledger, reconciliation with partners, e-invoices, tax, period close and accounting exports. The system never holds money: it records obligations and matches them against statements of licensed partners.

basis.label: Legal basis:
basis.review: Check against the original text / with a legal professional.

notes.orders_capture: The order is not delivered yet, so no revenue is recorded; revenue is recorded when the order becomes "Delivered". The Orders module posted this entry: correct it with a refund or cancellation on the order (which posts a reversal), not by reversing it here.
notes.orders_deliver: Posted by the Orders module when the order became "Delivered". Correct it with a refund or cancellation on the order (which posts a reversal), not by reversing it here.
notes.orders_capture_market: The money sits in the collection account of a licensed payment partner, not with the platform. The seller's share, marketplace fee and withheld tax are recorded when the order completes.
notes.marketplace_settle_market: Return window over: split into the seller's share, marketplace fee and withheld tax. Withholding applies only to household and individual sellers; rates come from the dated tax table (see the Tax tab).
notes.ledger_gateway_fee: Posted when reconciling the gateway statement: gateway fees are deducted from the payout.
notes.ledger_manual: Manual entry. If wrong, reverse it (needs ledger.reverse); the reversal is dated in an open period.

entry.title: Post manual entry
entry.intro: A posted entry cannot be edited, only reversed. Write a fixed description; never a buyer's name or phone number, because entries cannot be deleted.
entry.done: Entry posted; debits equal credits, sealed within 10 seconds
entry.descriptionHint: No buyer names, phone numbers or emails.
entry.dateHint: Must be in an open period.
entry.referenceHint: Sending the same reference again does not post twice.
entry.attachmentHint: Number of the payment or receipt voucher.

kpis.label: Key figures of the Bếp Mộc book
kpis.codSub: COD reconciliation is on the Shipping screen
kpis.prepaidSub: Collected, not delivered: not revenue yet
kpis.about: Movements of {month} in the Bếp Mộc book, computed from entry lines.

ledger.title: Recent entries
ledger.about: Every entry has at least two lines and total debits equal total credits. Entries are append-only: never edited or deleted; mistakes are fixed with a reversing entry. Every ten seconds the system seals new entries into a hash chain to detect tampering.
ledger.sealPending: Waiting for the sealing job (10 seconds)
ledger.reversedNote: Reversed by {reference}. An entry can be reversed only once.

reverse.title: Reverse entry {reference}
reverse.intro: The system posts a new entry that swaps debits and credits. The original stays and becomes "Reversed".
reverse.once: An entry can be reversed only once.
reverse.period: The reversal must be dated in an open period.
reverse.done: Reversal posted; the original is now "Reversed"
reverse.reasonHint: Say why, for example "Wrong debit account". No personal data.

ledger.bookNote: Store orders are recorded in the Bếp Mộc book. Marketplace orders are recorded in the Chợ Bếp Mộc book: the buyer's money sits with the collection partner, and the book only records what is owed to sellers.

trial.title: Trial balance · {book}
trial.about: Sums the debit and credit movements of every account.
trial.unbalanced: The columns differ: a sign of a system error; tell an administrator.
trial.foot: Balances are derived from entry lines; a periodic check recomputes them and reports any account that drifts. Chart-of-accounts numbers are used only for exports (see the Accounting export tab).

exceptions.title: Items to handle
exceptions.about: When incoming money matches no payment, the system does not guess; it puts the item here. Someone with ledger.reconcile chooses how to handle each item and records a reason.

kindHints.unmatched_credit: no payment code in the memo
kindHints.missing_in_statement: in the books, not in the statement
kindHints.unknown_in_statement: in the statement, not in the books

advice.amount_mismatch: The money went straight into the store's own account (self-collection); the system holds nothing. Usually: ask the buyer to transfer the rest and then match, or refund what was received and cancel the order.
advice.unmatched_credit: Probably a manual transfer without the code. Find an order waiting for exactly this amount and match it; if there is none, refund the sender.
advice.duplicate_payment: One payment received money twice: refund the extra to the buyer, then mark it "Refunded outside the system".
advice.missing_in_statement: Usually caused by the gateway's statement cut-off time. Reconcile again when the next day's statement is out; if still missing, contact the gateway.
advice.unknown_in_statement: A transaction in the statement that is not in the books, such as a gateway test transaction.
advice.late_payment: A cancelled order is not reopened. Direct transfers do not go through a gateway, so refund by hand and mark it "Refunded outside the system".

exceptions.noCandidates: No order at this receiving unit is waiting for exactly {amount}.
exceptions.candidates: Orders waiting for the same amount: {codes}.
exceptions.reconcileQueued: Reconciliation of the gateway statement for {date} is queued; new mismatches will show here
exceptions.reconcileNext: Reconcile again with the next day's statement

resolve.title: Resolve exception
resolve.intro: Choose how to handle it. "Match" posts through the same path as an automatic match. The reason is stored with your name.
resolve.codeHint: The short code in the transfer memo, such as AXK7Q2M9TP.
resolve.noteHint: For example: The buyer confirmed the short transfer and paid the rest.

exceptions.noCustody: Money goes straight into the store's account or the collection account of a licensed partner; this screen only matches the books with statements. COD reconciliation with carriers is on the Shipping screen.

runs.title: Recent reconciliations
runs.about: Every day the system pulls the gateway statement for the previous day and matches by transaction code and amount.
runs.opened: {count, plural, =0 {No new exceptions} one {# new exception} other {# new exceptions}}

bank.title: Accounts receiving transfers
bank.about: VietQR transfers go straight into the store's account. The system reads balance changes through a statement partner to match payments automatically; no platform account ever receives buyers' money. Only the last four digits of account numbers are shown.

add.title: Add receiving account
add.intro: The account must belong to the store or company, never to the platform. Connection details for the statement partner are entered under Settings › Partner connections and kept in the secret store.
add.done: Account added; turn on balance reading after connecting the partner
add.name: Account holder

pauseReasons.authorization_expired: The statement partner reported that the authorization expired

bank.pausedNote: While paused, transfer orders of {unit} must be confirmed by staff in Orders. Turning it back on catches up from the last cursor.
bank.notConnectedNote: Connect a statement partner under Settings › Partner connections, then turn on balance reading.
bank.activeNote: While paused, new transfers are not matched automatically.
bank.resumed: Turned back on; catching up from the last cursor

qr.title: Try a VietQR code
qr.about: A NAPAS VietQR code holds the bank code, account number, amount and memo. The page draws the QR image from the code string; trying it here creates no payment.
qr.cannot: Needs ledger.settings_manage and a connected account.
qr.memoHint: A short code of capital letters and digits only, because banks strip accents and cut memos short.
qr.expires: A real payment would expire at

due.title: Payment deadline
due.text: Transfer payments expire after {minutes} minutes (server setting). Money arriving later goes to the "Paid late" queue. The bank code list is data with its source and date.
due.custody: No platform account receives buyers' money.

kpis.label: E-invoice figures
kpis.rejectedSub: Fix and resend with the same number
kpis.registerSub: Sent to the tax authority the same day

einvoices.rejectedStrong: {count, plural, one {# invoice was rejected.} other {# invoices were rejected.}}
einvoices.rejectedText: The provider reported invalid buyer details. Fix the buyer details and resend: the invoice keeps its number; no new number is used.
einvoices.connectionStrong: The e-invoice provider connection has an error:
einvoices.title: Documents
einvoices.about: Invoices are made on delivery. Numbers are sequential per series with no gaps; drafts have no number. An invoice with a tax authority code can only be corrected with an adjusting or replacing invoice.

notes.draft: A draft has no number, so it can be edited or deleted. Issuing assigns the next number of the series and sends it to the provider.
notes.issued: Numbered; internal documents are not sent to a provider.
notes.submitting: The number was assigned before sending. If the provider fails, the system resends without a new number and checks the status every 5 minutes.
notes.accepted: Has a tax authority code: it cannot be edited. Correct mistakes with an adjusting or replacing invoice, or cancel it with an error notice.
notes.rejected: Ask the buyer for the correct details, then resend with the same number. A tax code has 10 digits, or 10 digits, a dash and 3 digits.
notes.cancelled: Cancelled by an error notice to the tax authority; still kept for the full period.
notes.replaced: Replaced by a new invoice; still kept for the full period.
notes.adjusted: Has a linked adjusting invoice; still kept for the full period.

fix.button: Fix and resend with same number
fix.title: Fix buyer details
fix.intro: The invoice keeps its series and number; only fix the reported fields and resend to the provider.
fix.done: Invoice resent with the same number; waiting for the provider's code
fix.taxCodeHint: Ask the buyer; a 12-digit personal ID needs checking against current rules.
fix.name: Company name
fix.addressPlaceholder: Number, street, ward / commune, province / city

einvoices.refreshed: Asked the provider again; the new status shows in the table

correct.title: Correct invoice {number}
correct.intro: An invoice with a tax authority code cannot be edited directly.
correct.adjustment: Adjust: make a draft adjusting invoice linked to the original (for example the buyer returned part of the goods).
correct.replacement: Replace: make a draft new invoice replacing the original (for example a wrong buyer name).
correct.cancel: Cancel by error notice: the original becomes "Cancelled" at once; this cannot be undone.
correct.done: Correction recorded; any correcting document is a draft, issue it to assign a number
correct.reasonHint: For example: The buyer returned 1 cast iron pan.

issue.title: Issue invoice · {symbol}
issue.number: Assigns the next number of the series; numbers have no gaps and cannot be taken back.
issue.keep: Once numbered, the invoice cannot be deleted and must be kept for at least 10 years.
issue.send: The invoice is sent to the provider to get a tax authority code.
issue.done: Number assigned and sent to the provider

delete.title: Delete draft invoice
delete.point: A draft has no number, so it can be deleted; an issued document cannot.

series.title: Invoice and document series
series.about: A series symbol shows the invoice kind and year, for example 1C26TBM: 1 is a VAT invoice, C means it carries a tax authority code, 26 is the year 2026. Each series has its own numbers; a new year uses a new series.

add.title: Add series
add.intro: Numbers of a new series start at 00000001.
add.symbolHint: Invoices: 1 digit, C or K, 2-digit year, 1 letter, 2 letters (1C27TBM). Withholding certificates: CT/27E.

facts.internal: Internal document (not sent to a provider)

series.gapless: A number is assigned only when issuing, in the same step as the document: no gaps, no duplicates.

deactivate.title: Retire series {symbol}
deactivate.keep: Documents already issued in this series keep their numbers.

series.foot: Series 2C26TNN and CT/26E are samples; check them against the rules on invoice and withholding certificate symbols.

mandates.title: Invoicing mandates
mandates.about: A marketplace seller can mandate the marketplace to issue invoices on its behalf. Without a mandate in effect, the marketplace cannot issue invoices for that seller.

add.title: Add invoicing mandate
add.intro: Without a mandate in effect, the marketplace cannot issue invoices for the seller.
add.signedHint: Attach it in the seller's file; the mandate must be notified to the tax authority.

revoke.title: Revoke mandate of {seller}
revoke.stop: The marketplace stops issuing invoices for this seller from now on.
revoke.issued: Invoices already issued under the mandate stay as they are.

expiring.products: {count, plural, one {# product uses} other {# products use}} this tax group.
expiring.successor: The "vn" pack version {pack} already has a {rate} row from {date}.
expiring.none: There is no next rate yet: a new tax data pack is needed.
expiring.extend: If the reduction is extended, the platform imports a new pack; customers do not edit their products.

vat.title: VAT by period
vat.about: Output is tax credited to the output VAT account; input is tax debited to the input VAT account, summed from the period's entry lines.
vat.snapshot: Each line keeps the rate used at the time, so changing the tax table does not change figures of past periods.
vat.foot: Provisional figures from the ledger, for checking; the tax return itself is not filed here.

rates.title: VAT table · vn pack version {pack}
rates.about: Each row has a start date (included) and an end date (excluded). The tax date follows the selling store's time zone, so 23:30 on 31 December Vietnam time is still the old year.
rates.foot: Rates are dated data in the "vn" pack, never hard-coded. Invoices and entries keep the rate used at the time.

withholding.title: Marketplace withholding
withholding.about: A marketplace that handles payments withholds and pays tax on behalf of household and individual sellers. Company sellers file their own.

quote.title: Try a tax calculation
quote.hint: Splits tax out of a tax-inclusive price, rounding once.
quote.later: With a tax date from {date} ({rate}): {net} and {tax}.
quote.snapshot: Documents keep a snapshot of the rate (pack {pack}, round half up).

profiles.title: Tax profile per unit
profiles.about: A unit without its own profile uses the profile of the nearest parent. The tax regime decides the invoice kind: credit method gives VAT invoices, household businesses give sales invoices.
profiles.createIntro: This unit uses the profile of {unit}. Saving here gives it its own profile and stops inheriting.
profiles.editIntro: New invoices use the new details; issued invoices keep their snapshot.
profiles.saved: Tax profile saved; new invoices use the new details
profiles.taxCodeHint: 10 digits, or 10 digits, a dash and 3 digits (dependent unit).

tiles.label: Tax data pack and rules
tiles.packText: Imported {imported}, sources checked {checked}: {rates} rates, {withholding} withholding rates, {rules} rules.
tiles.packWho: Only platform staff with tax.packs_manage import packs.
tiles.registerText: Household businesses with revenue from this threshold use cash register invoices, from {from}.
tiles.productsText: Products choose a tax group, not a rate: changing the rate needs no product edits.

periods.title: Periods of the {book}
periods.about: Periods close in month order. A closed period never reopens; new entries dated in it are refused. Mistakes in a closed period are fixed with a reversal in an open period.

check.title: Checks before closing
check.previous: The previous period ({month}) is not closed: periods close in month order.
check.ended: The period has not ended: closing early refuses entries for the remaining days.
check.sealed: {count, plural, one {# entry is} other {# entries are}} waiting to be sealed (the job runs every ten seconds).
check.balancedOk: Trial balance matches: total debit = total credit.
check.balanced: Trial balance does not match: tell an administrator before closing.
check.exceptionsOk: No open exceptions in the period.
check.exceptions: {count, plural, one {# exception} other {# exceptions}} of the period still open (does not block closing; better handle them first).
check.note: When closing, the system waits for entries being posted, then fixes the closing balance of every account. The next period's opening balances come from it. Needs ledger.periods_close.

close.title: Close period {month}
close.noReopen: A closed period cannot be reopened.
close.rejected: New entries dated in {month} will be refused.
close.reverse: Mistakes are fixed with a reversal in an open period.
close.snapshot: The closing balance of every account is fixed.
close.done: Period {month} closed and closing balances fixed

periods.closedNote: Closed: no new entries, never reopened.

integrity.title: Integrity checks
integrity.brokenText: A sealed entry was edited or deleted: tell an administrator now. Checked at
integrity.chainText: Recomputed {count} sealed entries: none edited or deleted; longest wait for a seal {minutes} minutes. Checked at
integrity.balancesText: A periodic check recomputes balances from entry lines and reports any account that drifts.
integrity.retentionText: Documents and books are kept for at least {years} years after the financial year; they cannot be deleted earlier.

export.title: Accounting export
export.intro: A job builds the export; download it from the Accounting export tab when it is ready.
export.done: Export queued; download it from the list when it is ready
export.formatHint: Sample data can only download CSV; XLSX waits for the API.

excel.title: Opens in Excel
excel.text: CSV uses UTF-8 with a BOM so Vietnamese text is not garbled; cells starting with = + - @ get a leading apostrophe so they do not become formulas. Profiles for specific accounting software are added only when the vendor publishes an import template.
excel.mapping: Account numbers follow the book's mapping (editable).

list.title: Recent exports
list.xlsxWaiting: XLSX download waits for the API

map.title: Account number mapping
map.about: The books use stable purposes (cash.bank, revenue.sales…); chart-of-accounts numbers are used only for exports.

codes.ledger_unbalanced: The entry is not balanced: total debit differs from total credit.
codes.ledger_unbalanced_amounts: The entry is not balanced: total debit {debit} differs from total credit {credit}.
codes.ledger_currency_mixed: Every line of an entry must use one currency.
codes.ledger_period_closed: The accounting period containing this date is closed. Post an adjusting entry in an open period.
codes.ledger_period_order: Close the previous period before this one.
codes.ledger_period_not_ended: This period has not ended; closing early refuses entries for the remaining days.
codes.ledger_period_not_found: This accounting period does not exist.
codes.ledger_already_reversed: This entry has already been reversed.
codes.ledger_payment_state: This payment is not waiting, so it cannot be matched (for example it expired or already succeeded).
codes.ledger_bank_account_taken: This account is already in the list.
codes.ledger_bank_account_not_found: This bank account does not exist.
codes.reference_reused: This reference was already used for a different entry. Use a new reference, or resend exactly the same content.
codes.invoices_document_state: The document is not in a state that allows this; reload the page.
codes.invoices_series_not_found: This document series does not exist.
codes.invoices_series_taken: This series already exists for this unit and year.
codes.invoices_mandate_missing: No mandate in effect lets you issue invoices for this seller.
codes.invoices_mandate_overlap: This seller already has a mandate in effect for these dates.
codes.invoices_retention_hold: Issued accounting documents must be kept for the full period and cannot be deleted.
codes.invoices_correction_pending: A correcting draft already exists for this invoice; issue or delete that draft first.
codes.invoices_export_not_ready: The export is not ready or cannot be built again.
codes.tax_category_unknown: This tax group does not exist.
codes.tax_rate_missing: There is no rate for this group on that date. A new tax data pack is needed.

fields.unknown: Choose a value from the list.
fields.money_vnd: Enter a whole number of dong above 0, such as 44000 or 44,000.
fields.personal_data: No phone numbers or emails: entries cannot be deleted.
fields.reference_format: Use 1 to 100 characters without accents or spaces.
fields.min_two_lines: An entry needs at least two lines: one debit and one credit.
fields.account_number: An account number has 6 to 19 digits.
fields.taken: This value is already in use.
fields.transfer_code: Capital letters without accents and digits only, up to 25 characters.
fields.tax_code: Enter 10 digits, or 10 digits, a dash and 3 digits.
fields.invoices_buyer_tax_code_invalid: The buyer tax code must have 10 or 13 digits (10-3 form).
fields.series_symbol: The symbol does not have the expected form (such as 1C27TBM; withholding CT/27E).
fields.series_year: The year in the symbol must match the Year field.
fields.after_start: Choose a date after the start date.
fields.one_side: Each line has one side only: debit or credit.
fields.line_account: Choose an account for this line.
fields.line_amount: Enter an amount in the debit or credit column.

promotions.crumb: Bếp Mộc · whole chain · website, counter and marketplace
promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.description: Create programs, discount codes and flash sales; check the legal cap before switching on, export the notice file for the Department of Industry and Trade and see the version history.

programs.kpiActiveSub: Codes, free delivery, buy X get Y
programs.kpiScheduledSub: Starts by itself at the start time
programs.title: Promotion programs
programs.about: A program goes draft → scheduled → running ↔ paused → ended. Switching it on is when the system checks the legal cap, the notice file and the targets.

limits.title: Legal caps in force
limits.about: The largest discount the law allows, stored as data with an effective date. When the law changes, load a new data pack; with no row in force, no program can be switched on.

evaluate.title: Try the discount on a cart
evaluate.about: Uses the same calculation as checkout, but holds no uses and writes nothing. Every discount comes with a reason buyers can read; programs that do not apply say why.
evaluate.groupHint: Leave empty for a walk-in buyer; for example SI-NHAHANG.
evaluate.linesHint: Separate with commas or new lines, for example CG26 × 1, KB4-XA × 2.
evaluate.codesHint: Up to 5 codes, separated by commas.
evaluate.feeHint: Used for free delivery; leave empty if not known yet.
evaluate.skipped: Programs that do not apply to this cart
evaluate.fingerprint: Result fingerprint: {value} (the order sends it back when holding uses).

legalNote.text: Cap of 50% of the price just before the promotion under Circular 39/2025/TT-BCT, with an exception for national focus programs; Decree 239/2026 amends Decree 81/2018. Numbers and effective dates need confirming by someone with legal expertise. Promotion conditions must be clear to buyers (Consumer Protection Law 19/2023).

detail.exclusive: Exclusive: a discounted line takes no other discount
detail.returnUsage: Return the use when an order is cancelled
detail.legalCap: {max}% of the price just before the promotion · {basis}
detail.legalNone: The law sets no cap for this type (to be checked)
detail.heldText: {count} uses held for orders waiting for payment (counted as used)
detail.prices: Price just before the promotion → price with the promotion
detail.codePriceNote: With a code to type, the listed price stays; the product page only adds a line “… with code …” and does not strike the price.

checks.title: Checks before switching on
checks.about: When you press “Switch on”, the system checks the conditions below in turn. If one is missing, the program is not switched on and the reason is shown.

legal_limit.title: Legal cap
legal_limit.badText: A {value}% discount is above the {max}% cap in force ({legal_basis}); or no legal data is in force.

reference_price.title: Price just before the promotion
reference_price.okText: Reference prices found in the price history.
reference_price.badText: Missing reference price: {missing}. Without it the cap cannot be checked, so it is blocked.

notice.title: Trade department notice
notice.okText: Submitted, or this type needs no notice (per the data, to be checked).
notice.badText: No submission recorded for {authority}; it must be submitted before {due}.

targets.title: Targets and slots
targets.okText: Targets set ({items} flash sale variants · {quantity} slots where used).
targets.badText: No targets yet: add variants / the gift before switching on.

window.title: Time
window.okText: The end is after the start and still in the future.
window.badText: The end has passed or is before the start.

history.activated: Switched on: passed the cap and notice checks

notes.draft: A draft can be edited freely. Switching it on is when the system checks the legal cap, the notice file and the targets.
notes.scheduled: Passed the switch-on checks; starts by itself at the start time. It can be cancelled before then.
notes.active: While running it can only be extended, given more uses, paused, ended, or have its translation edited without changing conditions. To change conditions, create a new program.
notes.paused: Paused: new carts get no discount; orders already holding a use keep it.
notes.ended: Ended. The version history keeps snapshots for buyer complaints or inspections.

actions.activateChecks: The system checks the legal cap, the price just before the promotion, the notice file and the targets; if one is missing, it is not switched on.
actions.activateLocked: Once on, it can only be extended, given more uses, paused or ended; changing conditions needs a new program.
actions.activateVersion: Version 1 is written to the history.
actions.paused: Paused; new carts no longer get the discount, held uses stay held
actions.endNow: New carts stop getting the discount from now.
actions.endHeld: Uses held for orders waiting for payment still count if the order is paid in time.
actions.endFinal: It cannot be resumed: to continue, create a new program.
actions.ended: Ended; a new version is written to the history
actions.cancelFinal: The program has not started and will be cancelled; it cannot be switched on again.

create.title: New promotion program
create.intro: A new program is a draft. When switched on, the system checks the legal cap in force, the notice file and the targets.
create.done: Draft created; add the buyer conditions, then switch it on
create.name: Name shown to buyers
create.nameHint: Short and clear about the benefit, for example “10% off cast iron pans”.
create.valueHint: Percent off: “10%”. Amount off, fixed price: whole đồng, for example 50000.
create.codeHint: When a code is needed: 4–32 capital letters, digits, dashes.
create.targetsHint: Empty = everything at the node; for example CG26, CG28.
create.exclusiveHint: A line that gets this program gets no other discount.

extend.title: Extend “{title}”
extend.intro: A running program can only be extended and given more uses, not shortened or changed. Each change becomes a new version.
extend.done: Saved; a new version is written
extend.endsHint: Currently ends at {ends}. Leave empty to only add uses.
extend.limitHint: Currently {limit} uses; it can only go up.

flash.none: There is no flash sale program yet.
flash.about: {window} (Vietnam time) · {slots} slots. Slots are per variant, held when ordering and released on cancellation, like stock.
flash.foot: Slots: {parts} = {total}. An order holds both the flash sale slot and the stock; without either, it cannot be placed.
flash.locked: The program is on: deal prices and slots can no longer change.
flash.editIntro: Price just before the promotion: {reference}. The cap in force allows {lowest} at the lowest. The change is written to the program history.

notice.title: Notice files
notice.about: Export the promotion notice data for the Department of Industry and Trade where the promotion runs, then record the submission. The system never submits to the public service portal itself.
notice.humanOnly: Autoxide only exports the data. A person submits it through the public service portal. CSV cells starting with = + − @ are neutralised so they never become formulas.
notice.recordIntro: Record it after submitting through the public service portal. It goes into the program history.

rules.title: Notice rules in force
rules.about: Which promotion types need a notice, how early and where — stored as data with an effective date that changes with the law.
rules.noteText: The notice procedure under Decree 81/2018 as amended by Decree 128/2024 — where to submit when a program runs in several provinces or only on the website, how many days ahead, and which types are exempt — needs confirming by someone with legal expertise.

vouchers.title: Codes
vouchers.about: Codes match regardless of case and spaces. “Left” is the real number from the counter, never rounded.
vouchers.remainingText: {left} uses · {held} held for orders waiting for payment
vouchers.listedPrice: With a code to type, the listed price stays; the website only adds a price line for the code and does not strike the price.
vouchers.holdText: Placing an order holds one use; payment confirms it, cancellation or an expired payment releases it. Many buyers using a code at once never go over the limit.

generate.title: Generate a batch of codes
generate.about: Codes are random and skip look-alike characters such as 0 and O, 1 and I. Above 500 codes a job does the work; at most 10,000 codes at once.
generate.queued: A job is generating {count} codes; download the CSV when it finishes
generate.prefixHint: Optional, up to 8 capital letters and digits.
generate.none: No program needs codes to generate.

versions.title: Versions
versions.about: From switch-on, every change to a program adds a version. Versions are only added — never edited or deleted.
versions.snapshotNote: Each version keeps a snapshot complete enough to rebuild the program as it was — for buyer complaints or inspections.

why.promotions_reason_order_min: {amount} off orders from {min_order}, spread over the lines
why.promotions_reason_capped_by_law: Discount limited to {max}% of the pre-promotion price by law
why.promotions_code_expired: Code {code} has expired or not started yet.
why.promotions_code_not_applicable: The cart does not meet the conditions for {code} yet: {condition}
why.promotions_skip_no_target_lines: the cart has no eligible product.
why.promotions_skip_no_reference_price: no price just before the promotion, so the cap cannot be checked.
why.promotions_skip_no_legal_data: no legal cap data is in force.
why.promotions_skip_exceeds_legal_limit: the gift value is above the {max}% cap.
why.promotions_skip_flash_sold_out: the deal slots for {sku} are gone.
why.promotions_skip_exclusive_taken: the line already has another program.
why.promotions_skip_no_shipping_fee: the delivery fee is not known yet.

codes.promotions_exceeds_legal_limit: The discount is above the legal cap in force ({detail}). Lower it, then switch on again.
codes.promotions_notice_required: The program must be notified to the Department of Industry and Trade before it starts; record the submission first.
codes.promotions_no_legal_data: No legal cap data is in force for this program type; it cannot be switched on.
codes.promotions_locked_after_start: A program that has run can only be extended, given more uses, paused or ended.
codes.promotions_invalid_transition: The program cannot move to that status.
codes.promotions_invalid_window: The end must be after the start and still in the future.
codes.promotions_reference_price_missing: No price just before the promotion ({detail}); the cap cannot be checked, so it is not switched on.
codes.promotions_targets_missing: The program has no targets yet (variants, gift).

fields.unknown: Choose a value from the list.
fields.money_minor: A whole number of đồng, no separators (690000).
fields.percent: Enter a percentage from 0.01 to 100, for example 10%.
fields.prefix_format: Up to 8 capital letters and digits.
fields.not_future: The submission date cannot be in the future.
fields.promotions_per_customer_over_total: Cannot be more than the total limit.
fields.promotions_extend_only: Extend only: choose a time after the current end.
fields.promotions_nothing_changed: Choose a new end time or enter a new use limit.
fields.promotions_not_a_discount: Must be below the price just before the promotion ({value} đồng).
fields.promotions_exceeds_legal_limit: Above the legal cap: {value} đồng at the lowest.
fields.promotions_not_code_based: This program does not use codes.
fields.promotions_invalid_transition: The program has ended or been cancelled.
fields.promotions_too_many_codes: A cart takes at most {value} codes.
fields.promotions_no_price: {value} has no price at this store.

shipping.crumb: Bếp Mộc · delivery methods inherited down the organisation tree
shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.description: Shipments, delivery fees, delivery calendar, cash on delivery (COD) reconciliation and carrier connections. For the people running deliveries for the chain and its stores.

codStatus.collected: collected by the carrier, waiting for the statement

carrierStatus.order_confirmed: order confirmed, shipment waiting to book
carrierStatus.return_to_sender: carrier is returning it to the sender

notes.pending: Check the goods, then book the carrier. Once there is a tracking number, the label can be printed (fetched from the carrier and cached for reprints).
notes.ready_to_ship: Tracking number issued; waiting for the carrier to collect. It can still be cancelled until pickup.
notes.delivery_failed: No cash was collected, so nothing is owed in the ledger. If it is returned, the order is cancelled and the goods go back to stock.
notes.returning: When it arrives back at the sender, confirm to put the goods back in stock.
notes.ready_for_pickup: Track and hand over at the counter: the buyer shows a 6-digit pickup code.
notes.delivered: Delivered with COD: the ledger records Debit “Receivable from carrier” / Credit “COD receivable from buyer”. Reconcile when the statement arrives.

shipments.kpiFailedSub: The carrier returns it after a third failed attempt
shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.about: One status set for every carrier: waiting to book → waiting for pickup → in transit → out for delivery → delivered; or delivery failed → redelivery / return. An old update arriving late never moves a status backwards.

detail.title: Shipment · {order}
detail.weightVolumetric: {weight} (volumetric weight is above the actual weight)
detail.weightActual: {weight} (actual weight is above the volumetric weight)

actions.bookCarrier: Sends a shipment request to {carrier}; the carrier returns a tracking number for the label.
actions.bookFee: The carrier charges by the parcels' chargeable weight; split parcels before this step.
actions.bookCancel: It can be cancelled until the carrier picks it up.
actions.booked: Request sent to the carrier; print the label once the tracking number arrives
actions.tracked: Asked the carrier; the latest status is in
actions.redeliverCarrier: The carrier gets the request and delivers again; the buyer is told.
actions.redeliverAttempts: {n} / {max} attempts so far; past the limit the carrier returns it.
actions.redelivered: Redelivery requested; the buyer is told

ledger.title: Ledger entries
ledger.about: Each money change (collection, revenue, refund) adds an entry that is never edited. Mistakes get a reversing entry, so every balance traces back to its source.
ledger.empty: No entries yet. The system posts once the partner reports a successful payment.
ledger.emptyCod: No entries yet. For COD the system posts when the carrier reports the money collected.
ledger.partnerNote: For marketplace orders the Marketplace module records the seller's share, fees and withheld tax when the order completes; Orders does not record seller revenue.
ledger.appendOnly: Append only; corrections are reversing entries.

returns.kpiApproved: Buyer sends or carrier picks up
returns.kpiRefundedSub: Through partners; the store never holds money
returns.title: Return requests
returns.about: Requests within {days} days after delivery. Refunds go through the payment gateway or the licensed collection partner; the store never holds buyers' money. Returns do not change the order's status.
returns.mediaCount: {n, plural, one {# photo or video} other {# photos or videos}}
returns.policyStrong: Return reasons and the return window are data.
returns.policy: The {days}-day window and the reason list are set per store in the order policy. Photos or an unboxing video are required for: {reasons}. Cash refunds at the counter come out of the open shift.
returns.mediaMissing: This reason needs photos, but none were attached.

approveNext.pickup: A pickup request goes to the carrier; goods come back to {place}.
approveNext.drop_off: The buyer sends the goods to {place} within 7 days.
approveNext.in_store: The buyer brings the goods to {place}.

returns.approveBuyer: The buyer is told what to do next.
returns.rejectIntro: The buyer receives the reason and how to complain further.
returns.rejected: Return rejected; the buyer gets the reason
returns.receiveIntro: Record the condition: restocked goods add to sellable stock; damaged goods do not.
returns.refundBody: Refunds exactly the lines received. A reversing entry and an adjustment invoice are recorded.

pos.title: Counter
pos.about: Scan or tap products, pick the customer and how they pay. A shift must be open at the store. Stock comes off that store; the invoice is generated from the cash register.
pos.searchHint: Scan a barcode, type a name or SKU — Enter adds it
pos.noMatch: No product matches. Clear the search or pick another group.
pos.noMoreStock: Only {stock} of {name} left at this store.
pos.goodsHint: Prices come from this store's price list and include VAT. Out-of-stock products are greyed out and listed last.
pos.noShift: No shift is open at this store.
pos.noHeld: No held orders. Use "Hold" to serve another customer and come back later.
pos.customerHint: Walk-in customer — search phone or name (F4)
pos.dropCustomer: Remove {name}, sell to a walk-in customer
pos.customerGone: This customer no longer exists. Pick another or sell to a walk-in customer.
pos.emptyCart: Scan a barcode or tap a product to add it to the order.
pos.estimate: Estimate. The server recalculates prices, promotions and VAT when the order is created, then opens the invoice to print.

carts.title: Abandoned carts
carts.about: Carts with items the buyer has not ordered in the last 30 days. Only buyers who agreed to receive messages are reminded (personal data protection law — check the original text); each cart at most {max} times.
carts.noConsent: Buyer has not agreed to messages
carts.template: Reminders use the “Abandoned cart” template in Marketing.

receipt.title: Invoice preview
receipt.description: Preview of the cash register invoice; print it from the browser.
receipt.heading: Cash register invoice
receipt.footer: Sample invoice: the real one comes from the e-invoice connector (Decree 123/2020 as amended by Decree 70/2025 — check the original text).

slips.title: Delivery slips
slips.heading: Delivery slip · {number}
slips.counter: Handed over at the counter to {name}

codes.orders_invalid_transition: The order cannot move to that status from where it is now.
codes.orders_refund_exceeds_paid: The refund is more than what is left to refund ({detail}).
codes.orders_nothing_to_refund: Nothing paid is left to refund.
codes.orders_return_invalid_transition: The return request is not at a step that allows this.
codes.orders_return_is_exchange: This request is an exchange; close it after handing over the new item.
codes.orders_return_window_closed: The return window for this order has closed.
codes.orders_payment_not_pending: This order is not waiting for payment.
codes.orders_cart_no_consent: The buyer has not agreed to receive messages.
codes.orders_cart_reminder_limit: This cart has already been reminded twice.
codes.orders_cart_reminder_sent: The reminder has already been sent.
codes.orders_pickup_invalid_state: The pickup is not at a step that allows this.
codes.orders_shift_not_open: No shift is open at this store. Open one first.
codes.orders_shift_already_open: This register already has an open shift.
codes.orders_out_of_stock: Not enough stock at this store.
codes.orders_review_reply_by_seller: Marketplace sellers reply to their own reviews.
codes.precondition_failed: Someone changed this order since you opened it. Reload and try again.

fields.unknown: Choose a value from the list.
fields.money_minor: A whole number of đồng, no separators (690000).
fields.orders_refund_exceeds_paid: At most {value} đồng can still be refunded.
fields.orders_variant_unavailable: {value} is not sold at this store.
fields.orders_pickup_code_invalid: The code does not match. Ask the buyer to read it again.
fields.orders_pickup_proxy_mismatch: The name does not match the person named on the order.
fields.orders_shift_already_open: Register {value} already has an open shift.
fields.orders_shift_difference_reason_required: The count differs by {value} đồng: write the reason.
fields.orders_moderation_reason_invalid: Choose a reason from the allowed list.

stores.title: Store operations
stores.description: Counter and after-sales work: store pickup, cashier shifts, returns at the counter, product reviews. Staff only see the stores they are assigned to.

pickup.title: Pickup queue
pickup.about: Orders the buyer chose to collect at a store. When ready, mark it: the buyer receives a 6-digit pickup code and the goods are held {days} days. If nobody comes, cancel: goods go back to stock and the money is refunded.
pickup.dueNote: The hold ends today: if the buyer does not come, cancel to put the goods back and refund through {method}.
pickup.codeNote: Staff never see the pickup code: the person collecting reads it and the system checks it. For someone collecting on the buyer's behalf, check the name and phone given on the order.
pickup.markedReady: {number} is ready; the buyer got a 6-digit code; held {days} days
pickup.resent: New pickup code sent; the old one no longer works
pickup.cancelStock: Goods go back to sellable stock at {store}.
pickup.cancelled: Pickup cancelled; goods back in stock, refund sent
pickup.handOverIntro: Enter the code the person reads out. For someone collecting on the buyer's behalf, the name must match the order.
pickup.handedOver: Handed over; the order is delivered and the e-invoice issued
pickup.codeHint: Never written down or shown to staff.
pickup.proxyHint: Only when someone collects on the buyer's behalf.
pickup.noProxy: No one else is named on this order.

shifts.kpiDiffSub: {n, plural, one {# shift} other {# shifts}} with a difference, reason recorded
shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.about: Each register has one open shift. Opening records the starting cash; closing counts the drawer. Expected cash comes from the counter orders in the shift; any difference needs a reason.
shifts.cashSales: Cash sales · {n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}}
shifts.otherOrders: {n, plural, =0 {No card or QR orders} one {# card or QR order} other {# card or QR orders}} (not in the drawer).
shifts.foot: Cash belongs to the store and is booked to that store's “cash at the counter” account; the system holds no money.
shifts.openIntro: One open shift per register. Count the starting cash before serving customers.
shifts.opened: Shift opened; counter sales go into it
shifts.closeIntro: Count all the cash in the drawer. Expected: {expected}. If it differs, write the reason.
shifts.closed: Shift closed; the report goes to the store manager
shifts.reasonHint: Required when the count differs from the expected amount.

returns.about: Returns brought to a store. Receive the goods (or record a walk-in return), note their condition, then refund — cash comes out of the open shift — or exchange.
returns.newTitle: Record a return at the counter
returns.newIntro: For a buyer who brings goods back without a request. Within the return window only.

reviews.title: New reviews
reviews.about: Reviews from people who received the goods appear at once. Never hide a review because it is negative; hide only for a reason on the allowed list, and the writer is told why.
reviews.sellerNote: The seller replies in the seller centre; the marketplace only moderates.
reviews.negativeNote: Complaints about quality are not a reason to hide. Reply publicly with how you are handling it.
reviews.flagNote: This can be hidden for “contains contact details”; the complaint itself stays a valid opinion — suggest the writer posts again without the phone number.
reviews.replyNote: A short public reply builds trust.
reviews.published: Review showing again; the writer is told
reviews.law: Hiding reviews against the rules breaches the Consumer Protection Law 19/2023 (check the original text). Each hide records who, why and when; it can be undone.
reviews.replyIntro: The reply shows publicly under the review, with the store's name.
reviews.replied: Reply sent; the writer is told
reviews.hideIntro: Only reasons on the allowed list. Never hide because a review is negative. The writer receives the reason.
reviews.hidden: Hidden; who, why and when are recorded and the writer is told

ai.title: AI review summaries
ai.about: AI only writes a draft. Staff approve it before it shows, with an “AI summary” label. A summary must keep the negative points.
ai.approved: Summary showing on the product page with the “AI summary” label
ai.dropped: Draft dropped; a new one is made after 20 more reviews

work.title: Work and activity
work.description: Everything waiting for you, recent activity, pinned items and notification settings. Work comes from each area's data and leaves the list once handled where it came from.

box.title: Work to do
box.about: Gathered from every area you have permission for. There is no "mark as done": an item leaves the list once its record is handled.
box.empty: Nothing left. New work shows here when an area has data to handle.
box.incomplete: {count, plural, one {# work source did not answer} other {# work sources did not answer}}: {names}. Their work is missing from the list; reload the page to try again.
box.sampleNote: Items tagged "sample" come from sample data of areas without an API yet; comments, form submissions and posts waiting for review come from the real core. Snoozing and assigning are kept in sample data until the core has the API.
box.whyText: You see this because you hold {permission} at {scope}.
box.whyAny: You see this because you may handle it at {scope}.
box.sampleTitle: Sample data · waiting for the API of step {step}: {endpoint}
box.snoozeIntro: "{title}" leaves the waiting list until the time you pick, then comes back. Hidden for you only; others still see it.
box.assignIntro: "{title}" stays here until it is handled where it came from; the assignee sees it was given to them.
box.assignHint: Only people who may handle this work (by their roles) are listed.

websiteDossier.platform: {domain} is not registered as a marketplace with the Ministry of Industry and Trade

kycPending.title: {count, plural, one {# identity check (KYC) awaiting review} other {# identity checks (KYC) awaiting review}}

incident.title: Incident {reference} not yet reported to the authority
incident.detail: Severity {severity, select, high {high} medium {medium} other {low}}; the deadline runs from detection

invoicesRejected.title: {count, plural, one {# e-invoice rejected} other {# e-invoices rejected}}
invoicesRejected.detail: Fix and resend with the same invoice number

ledgerExceptions.title: {count, plural, one {# reconciliation exception open} other {# reconciliation exceptions open}}
ledgerExceptions.detail: Payments or statements not matching the ledger

taxExpiring.detail: {products, plural, one {# product uses} other {# products use}} this tax group; {next, select, none {no next rate yet} other {{next}% applies from {from}}}

metrics.formsNote: On {forms, plural, one {# form} other {# forms}}

steps.moitNotify: Notify the Ministry of Industry and Trade of the sales website
steps.moitRegister: Register the marketplace with the Ministry of Industry and Trade
