setup.basis: Steps marked "Required by law" must be done before selling (e-commerce: Decree 52/2013 as amended by Decree 85/2021 — check the original text).

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.about: Readable lines built from the core's audit log: who did what, and when. Sign-ins and password changes are personal and not shown here.
activity.forbidden: Seeing activity needs {permission}. Once the core lists activity by read permission on each record (step 51), everyone sees activity within their scope.

pins.title: Pinned items
pins.about: Views and records you pinned to open quickly. Pins are yours only.

dryRun.title: Dry-run a bulk action
dryRun.about: Bulk actions run as a dry run first: the system says which records would change, be skipped or fail, and writes nothing. Agree, and it runs for real as a job. Sample action: change the tax group of every product in a category.
dryRun.none: This category has no products yet.
dryRun.runPoint1: {count, plural, one {# product moves} other {# products move}} to the group "{tax}"; prices and new orders use the new group as soon as the run ends.
dryRun.runPoint2: It runs only if the number of matching products is still {count}, as in the dry run; otherwise it stops and tells you.
dryRun.runPoint3: There is no undo for the whole batch: run a new action to change it back. Orders already placed keep the tax of when they were placed.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.about: Choose when you hear about things. Notifications are messages to you; work to handle lives in the work box.

mention.label: When someone mentions me (@)
mention.hint: In the app and by email

assigned.label: When work is assigned to me

approval.label: When an agent asks for approval
approval.hint: In the app and by email; requests expire after 24 hours

notify.languageNote: Notifications sent later (summary emails, reminders) do not know your language yet, because the core does not store a "preferred language"; listed as a missing API.

customers.crumb: Bếp Mộc · whole chain · customer profiles and retention
customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Know your customers and keep them: purchase profiles, rule-based groups, points and tiers, abandoned-cart reminders, referrals and COD risk. For customer care, marketing and store managers; store staff see only their own branch’s customers.

profiles.title: Customer list
profiles.about: Each buyer has one profile, linked to an account or to a phone number. A phone-only profile is linked to an account only after the number’s owner verifies it, so nobody can take another person’s points.
profiles.searchHint: Name (accents optional), phone number or email
profiles.noteAccount: Phone and email are partly hidden on screen. Total spent counts only completed orders (past the return window) minus refunds; orders still in delivery are not counted.
profiles.notePhone: Profile keyed by phone number (HMAC per customer, not comparable across customers). Staff registering at the counter do not tie it to any account until the number’s owner verifies it.
profiles.legal: Profiles, groups and purchase history are personal data processing: purpose and basis are recorded in the Compliance register; customers can see and delete their data (Law 91/2025 on personal data protection, Decree 356/2025 — check the original text).

add.title: Add a customer at the counter
add.intro: Registered by phone number. The profile belongs to no account until the number’s owner registers and verifies the number.
add.phoneHint: Normalised and hashed per customer; never shown in full again.
add.name: Full name

note.title: Internal note · {name}
note.intro: Notes are personal data: included when the customer asks for an export, deleted when they delete their account.

tags.title: Tags · {name}
tags.hint: Separate with commas; up to 10 tags. Groups by tag update within a minute.

points.title: Adjust points · {name}
points.ledger: Each point is a liability of {value} in the ledger; the adjustment posts a journal entry.
points.final: The points ledger is append-only: this cannot be undone, only offset by another adjustment.
points.referenceHint: Sending the same reference again does not add twice.

accounts.title: Buyer accounts
accounts.about: Buyers sign in with their own Bếp Mộc account and hold no permissions. Staff need auth.customers.read to view and auth.customers.manage to lock or unlock. Nobody can see passwords.
accounts.notVerifiedEffect: Not yet — can buy, but cannot comment or review (Decree 147/2024)
accounts.locked: Locked; every session of this person was revoked.
accounts.unlocked: Unlocked; the buyer can sign in again.
accounts.noPassword: An account without a verified phone can still buy, but cannot be linked to a phone-number profile.
accounts.selfSignupHint: When off, the sign-up page returns auth.customer_registration_closed; guests can still check out.
accounts.unverifiedCount: {n} accounts have not verified their phone number.
accounts.unverifiedText: They can still buy but cannot comment or review yet (Decree 147/2024 — check the original text). Phone verification belongs to Compliance (step 37).

segments.title: Groups
segments.about: Manual or rule-based. Groups are re-evaluated when a profile changes and every night; price lists (step 41) and promotions (step 43) use groups by ID, never reading customer data.
segments.manualRule: Staff add profiles one by one
segments.consentNote: Using a group for marketing messages still filters by each person’s consent.
segments.deletePoint1: Members leave the group; their profiles stay.
segments.deletePoint2: A group used by a price list or a promotion cannot be deleted.
segments.legalText: Purpose and basis are recorded in the Compliance register. Using groups for marketing needs the customer’s consent (Law 91/2025, Decree 356/2025 — check the original text).

group.title: New customer group
group.intro: Name it and set the rule. Empty fields are not checked.
group.name: Group name

preview.title: Try a rule
preview.about: Counts matching profiles before you save anything.
preview.result: {matched} profiles match; {consented} of them agreed to marketing messages.

loyalty.kpiExpiringSub: At end of day, Vietnam time
loyalty.kpiHeldSub: Released if the order is cancelled
loyalty.rulesAbout: Rules are data with an effective date. Rows already in effect are never edited: add a new row and the previous one closes. Points keep the value they had when earned, so the ledger stays balanced when the point value changes.
loyalty.rulesLegal: Programme conditions are public to buyers before they take effect (Law 19/2023 on consumer protection — check the original text). Points are earned when an order completes (past the return window).
loyalty.tiersAbout: Tiers are reviewed daily on spending over the last 12 months. Each tier has an earning multiplier and may be tied to a customer group.
loyalty.adjustAbout: Only staff with customers.loyalty.adjust can adjust, from a customer’s profile. Each adjustment has a reference (resending it does not add twice) and a reason, recorded in the append-only points ledger.
loyalty.reviewAbout: The reward is data with an effective date and is shown on the buyer’s review button. It does not depend on the star rating or on praise: rewarding only good reviews would make them conditional.
loyalty.reviewLegal: Rewarded reviews and their disclosure: check the original text of the consumer protection and e-commerce rules with a legal professional.
loyalty.storedTitle: Gift cards and store credit: off.
loyalty.storedText: Turning them on takes two layers: the operator sets AUTOXIDE_CUSTOMERS_STORED_VALUE_ENABLED and the customer’s plan includes the feature. When on, cards buy only from Bếp Mộc, cannot be cashed out or transferred (Decree 52/2024 — check the original text with a legal professional before turning on).

loyaltyRule.title: New points rule
loyaltyRule.intro: A rule cannot start in the past (customers.rule_effective_in_past). The rule in effect closes the day before.
loyaltyRule.fromHint: Publish the conditions to buyers before this date.
loyaltyRule.done: Rule added; the current rule closes the day before.

carts.title: Abandoned carts are listed in Orders
carts.about: Carts and the remind button belong to Orders. This tab keeps the reminder rule: consent is checked when scheduling and again when sending; placing the order or withdrawing consent cancels the schedule.
carts.legalText: Send only with prior consent, stop at once when refused, within allowed hours, with an unsubscribe link in every message. A replacement for Decree 91/2020 is in draft — check the original text.

reminder.title: Reminder rule
reminder.about: A new rule takes effect tomorrow; carts already scheduled keep their schedule.
reminder.delaysHint: Up to 3, increasing, between 15 minutes and 7 days, e.g. 60, 1440.
reminder.done: Rule saved; it takes effect tomorrow.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.about: Each customer has a code. The referred person enters it within 14 days of creating an account and before the first order; the reward is given when that first order completes and reaches the minimum.
referrals.selfReferral: same phone number as the referrer
referrals.once: The reward job runs within minutes and rewards once; a redelivered event never rewards again. Same phone, email or device as the referrer means rejected.
referrals.rulesAbout: Referral rules are data with an effective date and are public to buyers. Rewards are points by default (no gift card needed).
referrals.whenCompleted: When the friend’s first order completes
referrals.newRuleText: Add a row with an effective date; the old one closes.
referrals.legal: Referral conditions are transaction terms and must be public to buyers (Law 19/2023 — check the original text).

referralRule.title: New referral rule
referralRule.intro: A rule cannot start in the past.

cod.rulesAbout: Rules are data with an effective date. When a buyer matches, the order needs prepayment or cannot use COD; the buyer can still buy another way.
cod.legalText: Transaction conditions must be clear to buyers (Law 19/2023, Decree 55/2024 — check the exact articles). Prefer asking for prepayment over refusing to sell.
cod.lifted: Block lifted; the buyer can use COD again.

codRule.title: New COD rule
codRule.intro: Needs orders.risk.manage. The rule applies to orders placed from its effective date; the current rule of the same kind closes the day before.

lookup.title: Look up a buyer
lookup.hint: The number is normalised and hashed before the lookup; it is not stored.
lookup.found: At Bếp Mộc: delivered {delivered}, failed {failed}, refused {refused} ({ratio}% failed).
lookup.notFound: No COD history at Bếp Mộc for this number.

block.title: Block COD for a phone number
block.intro: A block always has an end date and a reason. A blocked buyer can still buy with prepayment.
block.done: COD blocked until the chosen date.

codes.customers_phone_taken: This phone number already has a customer profile.
codes.customers_group_name_taken: A group with this name already exists.
codes.customers_group_in_use: The group is used by a price list or promotion; remove it there first.

fields.unknown: Choose a value from the list.
fields.number_invalid: Enter a whole number in the allowed range.
fields.customers_phone_invalid: Enter a Vietnamese mobile number such as 09xx xxx xxx.
fields.customers_phone_taken: This number already has a profile: {value}.
fields.customers_points_invalid: Enter a whole number other than 0, e.g. +200.
fields.customers_reference_used: This reference was already used for another adjustment.
fields.customers_rule_invalid: Enter a whole number in the allowed range.
fields.customers_rule_empty: A rule group needs at least one condition.
fields.customers_delays_invalid: Up to 3 increasing values, 15 to 10080 minutes.
fields.customers_block_until_past: Choose a date in the future.

channels.crumb: Bếp Mộc · multichannel selling · one stock, orders in one place
channels.title: Sales channels
channels.description: Sell on your website and on marketplaces and social networks at once, with one stock and one product list. For owners, warehouse and accounting: connect channel accounts, link products, allocate stock, handle channel orders and reconcile what channels pay.

accountNote.active: Stock and prices are pushed after each change; orders are pulled every few minutes and also arrive by push notifications.
accountNote.paused: Paused: no stock or price pushes and no order pulls; orders already imported are still handled.
accountNote.reauth_required: While waiting, new orders on the channel do not reach Autoxide; after reconnecting, the order pull continues from the old cursor so nothing is missed.
accountNote.unavailable: Install the channel’s connector module and restart the server; the account starts once its key is verified.
accountNote.disconnected: Disconnected: the key was deleted; order and reconciliation history is kept.

accounts.noteText: Each marketplace or social network connector is a separate module, installed once you have a partner account. Accounts of a channel without a connector stay at “No connector” and do not affect other channels.
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.about: Each account belongs to a store and takes stock from its linked warehouses. The connection key lives in Bếp Mộc’s secret store, is decrypted only right before calling the channel, is never shown again and never logged.
accounts.paused: Paused: no stock, price pushes or order pulls.
accounts.resumed: Running again; a full stock check was queued.
accounts.credentialsSet: In the secret store · never shown again
accounts.disconnect1: The connection key is deleted from the secret store.
accounts.disconnect2: No more stock, prices or orders sync with this account.
accounts.disconnect3: Order and reconciliation history is kept. This cannot be undone: reconnecting needs a new key.

connectors.title: Installed connectors
connectors.about: From the server: which channels have a connector and what it can do. If a channel cannot do something, Autoxide reports channels.capability_unsupported.
connectors.needModule: Needs its own connector module and a partner account

connect.title: Connect a channel account
connect.intro: The key goes straight into Bếp Mộc’s secret store and is checked with the channel at once; it is never shown after saving.
connect.kindHint: Only channels with an installed connector.
connect.name: Account name
connect.tokenHint: Paste the key issued by the channel. It is never shown again.
connect.done: The channel accepted the key; the account is running.

sync.done: Queued a full stock and price push to running accounts.

reconnect.title: Reconnect {name}
reconnect.intro: Paste the new key from the channel; it is checked at once and never shown again.
reconnect.tokenHint: Stored in the secret store only.
reconnect.done: The channel accepted the new key; the account is running again.

listings.title: Products on channels
listings.about: Link catalog variants with codes on each channel. Without a channel price the channel uses the store’s price list; you can add or remove a percentage (rounded up to 1,000 ₫) or set a fixed price from a date.
listings.published: Publishing queued; the result arrives within minutes.
listings.delist1: The product is removed from sale on the channel.
listings.delist2: The code link is kept so old orders still match. Publishing again creates a new channel listing.
listings.delisted: Delisted on the channel; the code link is kept.
listings.missingAttr: missing the channel’s required “Material” attribute for Ceramics
listings.taxNote: Channel prices include tax. When an order is imported, tax is recalculated by Autoxide’s tax engine; the channel’s tax figures are not trusted.

link.title: Link a product to a channel
link.intro: A channel code links to one variant per account (channels.sku_taken).
link.done: Linked; press “Publish” to put it on sale.

alloc.title: Allocation · {account} · {target}
alloc.intro: Shares of accounts using the same warehouse cannot exceed 100% (channels.allocation_invalid). Reserving needs enough stock; otherwise you see how many can be held.
alloc.done: Saved; a stock push was queued.

stock.title: Allocation rules
stock.about: “By share”: the channel gets part of the common stock minus the buffer; nothing is held in the warehouse. “Reserved”: the channel has units really held in the warehouse, which the website and other channels cannot sell. Shares do not exceed 100%.
stock.previewAbout: Read from Inventory at the moment of the push, never from the event payload.
stock.previewFoot: {name}: {available} available in the linked warehouses (order holds already deducted), {reserved} reserved for channels; the website can sell {website}. Pushed quantities are never negative.
stock.warnTitle: Autoxide does not oversell, but channels lag.
stock.warnText: Every web, counter and channel order holds stock, so stock never goes negative. If two channels sell the last unit within the few seconds before sync, the later imported order becomes “Oversold”. Use a buffer or reserve fast sellers to reduce this.
stock.debounce: Changes within 5 seconds are pushed once; full check every 6 hours

inboundNote.needs_mapping: Link each channel code with a catalog variant; the link is saved so later orders match by themselves, and the order is imported as soon as every line is linked.
inboundNote.imported: Handled in Orders like any other order; the channel account and channel order code are on the order.
inboundNote.oversold: Choose to restock and deliver, or cancel on the channel with the reason “out of stock”.
inboundNote.conflict: Usually the buyer returned the item through the channel. Check with the channel, then create a return in Orders, or close the conflict if the channel sent it by mistake.
inboundNote.failed: The channel rejected the key; reconnect the account, then run the import again.

inbound.title: Channel orders
inbound.about: Channel orders arrive by push notifications and periodic pulls; a channel resending the same order still creates one order. Orders missing a link, oversold or with a status conflict wait here for a person.

resolved.cancel_on_channel: Cancelled on the channel (out of stock)

inbound.keep1: The order holds stock automatically when the receipt reaches the warehouse.
inbound.keep2: The channel’s shipping deadline still applies.
inbound.kept: Order kept; it holds stock when goods arrive.
inbound.cancelWhereText: The channel ({account}) refunds the buyer; Autoxide holds no money
inbound.cancelWarn: This cannot be undone: the order is cancelled in Autoxide and on the channel, and the channel may penalise the shop.
inbound.cancelled: Cancel queued on the channel; the order was cancelled.
inbound.foot: Buyer phone numbers are partly hidden by channels: used only for delivery, never for COD-fraud checks, not counted in COD statistics.

map.title: Link line {sku}
map.intro: The channel sent “{title}”. The link is saved for this account; the order is imported once every line is linked.
map.done: Link saved; the order was imported if every line is linked.

conflict.title: Close the conflict on {number}
conflict.intro: The note and your name are saved on the channel order. This cannot be undone.

mismatch.refunded_but_paid: Cancelled in Autoxide, channel still paid

mismatchHint.refunded_but_paid: Ask the channel to deduct it next period, or note and close.
mismatchHint.order_not_found: Placed before the account was connected: enter it manually in Orders or close with a note.

ledger.bank: Channel pays out to the bank

settle.kpiMismatchSub: Statement posts once they are resolved
settle.title: Payout statements
settle.about: Every day Autoxide pulls each channel’s payout statement, matches every line with an order and posts to the ledger. Mismatched lines go to a manual queue. Statements and entries are kept at least 10 years (Accounting Law 88/2015).
settle.postedAt: Posted: fees {fees} to channel fee expense, the rest moved from channel receivable to bank clearing.
settle.waitMismatch: {n} mismatched lines: the statement is posted once they are resolved.
settle.readyToPost: Every line matches; ready to post.
settle.taxNote: Tax withheld by the channel exists only when the seller is a household or individual business (Decree 117/2025 — check the original text); Bếp Mộc is a company, so there is no such line.
settle.postWarn: This cannot be undone: corrections are new reversing entries.
settle.mismatchAbout: Each statement line is matched with an order by the channel order code. It mismatches when no order is found, or when the channel’s amount differs from Autoxide’s.
settle.ledgerAbout: Importing a channel order already recorded a channel receivable. The statement records fees, subsidy and money to the bank; what remains receivable is what channels still owe.
settle.owedAbout: Money collected by channels for imported orders, minus statement lines already posted.

line.title: Resolve mismatch · {order}
line.intro: The note and your name are saved on the reconciliation line. This cannot be undone.

report.kpiFeesSub: Statements with a period inside the range
report.title: By channel
report.about: Revenue includes tax, minus cancelled orders and refunds, by order date. Fees and net come only from channel statements; orders without a statement are still fully owed by the channel. Needs channels.read and orders.reports.read.
report.feesIn: Fees in statements of the period
report.extNote: Statements arrive daily; until then the channel owes the whole order amount.
report.ownNote: Payment gateway fees are in Finance.
report.foot: Lazada and Facebook have no connector, so no orders yet. The {n} marketplace orders of Chợ Bếp Mộc are sellers’ revenue — see the Marketplace module.
report.ledgerAbout: Importing a channel order records a channel receivable equal to the money collected. Collected minus posted statements must equal the receivable balance.

affiliate.crumb: Bếp Mộc · affiliate and livestream programme
affiliate.title: Affiliate marketing
affiliate.description: Sell through affiliates (KOLs, KOCs) and livestreams within the law: affiliates and hosts verify their identity before they act; commissions follow rules with effective dates; payouts withhold personal income tax. For marketing and accounting.

gate.affiliate_terms_not_accepted: acceptance of the current programme terms

partners.title: Affiliates and hosts
partners.about: Order: awaiting verification (identity for the right purpose, phone, terms) → awaiting approval → active ↔ suspended → terminated. Expired verification or new terms suspend automatically; approved commissions are never lost.
partners.secretSet: In the secret store · not shown
partners.gateNote: Every time a link is created, an order attributed, a session opened or money paid, the status and verification expiry are checked again (one function, PartnerGate).
partners.approved: {name} approved; they can create links and earn commission from now on.
partners.legal: Affiliates and livestream hosts must verify their identity (E-commerce Law 122/2025/QH15, from 1 July 2026; the guiding decree’s exact articles — check the original text). Accounts must be verified before livestreaming (Decree 147/2024/ND-CP).
partners.oneLevelText: No multi-level commissions: they easily become multi-level marketing, which has its own law.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}
suspend.intro: Links stop attributing new orders; approved commissions are still paid. You can reopen later.

terminate.title: Terminate {name}?
terminate.point1: Links and the code stop working at once.
terminate.point2: Approved commissions are still paid in the next period; tax records are kept.

rule.title: New commission rule
rule.intro: A rule cannot start in the past (affiliate.rule_in_past); the same scope on the same date is affiliate.rule_overlap.
rule.priorityHint: Higher wins when several rules fit.
rule.done: Rule added; orders placed from that date use the new rate.

rules.title: Rules
rules.about: Rules are data with effective dates, append-only, never edited. An order uses the rule in effect when it was placed; the rate is snapshotted on the commission line, so changing rules never changes old commissions.
rules.close1: Orders placed until today keep their snapshotted rate.
rules.close2: A closed rule cannot be reopened; add a new rule instead.
rules.closed: Closed from tomorrow; earlier orders keep their snapshotted rate.

preview.title: Preview a commission
preview.about: Price, discount and tax as the server computes for a real order.
preview.result: {name}: {price}, discount {discount} → {net} incl. VAT → base {base}. Rule “{rule}” {rate}% → commission {amount}.

program.title: Programme settings
program.about: Data per customer; a new attribution window applies to clicks from now on.
program.autoHint: Off: every profile waits for a person.

commissions.title: Commission lines
commissions.about: One commission line per attributed order line. Placed → awaiting completion; cancelled → void; completed (past the return window) → approved and posted; paid in a payout → paid. Buying through your own link is never attributed.
commissions.adjustAbout: A refund after approval or payment adds a negative line deducted from the next payout. If it exceeds the period’s commission, it carries over; the affiliate is never asked to pay back.
commissions.noAdjust: No negative adjustments: no attributed order was refunded after approval.
commissions.ledgerNote: Approving posts Debit commission expense / Credit payable to the affiliate; a refund after approval posts the reverse.

payouts.kpiWithheldSub: Paid on their behalf, certificate issued
payouts.moneyTitle: Commission money is Bếp Mộc’s own money.
payouts.moneyText: Autoxide holds no money: payouts go through a licensed payout partner, or accounting transfers manually and records the transaction code. One payout per person per period, never split to avoid the withholding threshold.
payouts.title: Payouts for {from} – {to}
payouts.about: Withholding is computed on the whole payout (after negative adjustments) using tax data in effect on the payment date; the snapshot is kept on the payout.
payouts.viaGateway: Licensed payout partner (same reference: never paid twice)
payouts.retryWarn: This sends money and cannot be undone. Make sure the affiliate fixed their payout account.
payouts.retried: Payout sent again with the same reference.
payouts.carried: Commission from orders before the sample data
payouts.snapshotNote: Rate and threshold are read from tax data in effect on the payment date and saved on the payout; changing tax data later does not change this payout.
payouts.pitAbout: Autoxide writes no tax figures in code. Rates and thresholds are tax data with effective dates; change the data and the next payment uses the new figures.
payouts.rateFrom: {pct}% when a payment is {threshold} or more
payouts.pitLegal: PIT on commissions of individuals without a labour contract: 10% per payment from 2,000,000 ₫ (Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC, Article 25); sources say Decree 253/2026 raises the threshold to 5,000,000 ₫ — check the original text. Electronic withholding certificates: Decree 123/2020 amended by Decree 70/2025 — check the form. {n} rows of tax data.

paid.title: Record the transfer to {name}
paid.warn: Use this when accounting already transferred the money. Autoxide posts the ledger and issues the withholding certificate if any. This cannot be undone.
paid.referenceHint: Recording the same code again does not post twice.
paid.done: Recorded as paid; ledger entry and certificate queued.

schedule.title: Schedule a livestream
schedule.intro: The host must have verified their identity for livestreaming and their phone number; the plan’s affiliate.livestream feature must be on.
schedule.done: Session scheduled; pin products before going live.

pin.title: Pin a product · {title}
pin.intro: Only products on sale can be pinned (affiliate.variant_not_sellable). The announced price is written to the session log.
pin.done: Product pinned; written to the session log.

live.noVideoText: A session points to the streaming platform; Autoxide keeps the host, pinned products, announced prices and the session log (append-only, kept 5 years — the period is configuration; check the decree guiding the 2025 E-commerce Law).
live.title: Sessions
live.staffHost: {name} · store staff, identity verified for livestreaming
live.priceNote: The price buyers pay is still computed by Orders on the server. Orders placed within 30 minutes after the session ends are still attributed to it.
live.start1: The host’s livestream verification and phone are checked again.
live.start2: Orders from the session are attributed from now on; this is written to the log and cannot be undone.
live.started: Session started; orders are attributed from now on.
live.end1: Orders within 30 minutes after the end are still attributed.
live.end2: An ended session cannot be restarted; written to the log.
live.endedDone: Session ended; written to the log.

portal.preview: Preview of what {name} sees after signing in with affiliate.partner: only their own data.
portal.linksAbout: A buyer who clicks your link and orders within {days} days is attributed to you.
portal.disable1: New clicks are no longer attributed; clicks still in their window remain attributed.
portal.disable2: A link cannot be turned back on; create a new one instead.
portal.privacy: A click stores only a hashed IP address and the browser family, deleted after 90 days (Law 91/2025 on personal data protection).
portal.taxAbout: Every payment with withholding has an electronic PIT withholding certificate. At year end there is a summary of income and tax withheld for your own settlement.
portal.taxForm: Form per Decree 70/2025 — check the form
portal.taxStatement: Annual summary available at year end

link.title: Create a link
link.intro: The new link works at once; buyers who click it and order within {days} days are attributed to you.

codes.affiliate_invalid_transition: This status change is not allowed.

codes.affiliate_phone_verification_required: Phone verification is required before livestreaming.

codes.affiliate_rule_not_active: Only rules in effect can be closed.
codes.affiliate_payout_not_retryable: This payout cannot be paid again in its current status.
codes.affiliate_payout_account_missing: No payout account has been provided.
codes.affiliate_payee_name_mismatch: The payee name does not match the account
codes.affiliate_session_not_live: The session has not started or has already ended.
codes.affiliate_variant_not_sellable: This product is not on sale and cannot be pinned.
codes.affiliate_link_not_found: The link does not exist or is turned off.

revoke.summary: Revoking works at once; then check the request log

tasks.label: Work to do
tasks.title: Where does this work come from?
tasks.body: Each item comes from an area you have permission for: an order waiting for confirmation, a missing document, an agent command waiting for approval. Handle it where it came from and it leaves the list by itself.

setup.label: Setup steps
setup.title: Setup steps
setup.body: What must be done before selling, by law and by the plan in use. Legal steps must be done before you start selling; the others can wait.

saved_views.label: Saved views
saved_views.title: What is a view?
saved_views.body: A view keeps the filters you use under a name, to reopen them in one click. Personal views are only yours; a node's views are shared with everyone at that node.
saved_views.example: Example: a view “Awaiting at District 3” opens the orders waiting for that store.

required_pages.label: Required pages
required_pages.title: Why are some pages required?
required_pages.body: Buyers must be able to read who sells, how to pay, how to return goods and how to complain before they buy. A missing page is flagged here and under Compliance.

websites.label: Websites
websites.title: One domain, one website
websites.body: Each website belongs to one organization unit, so people at that unit or a parent unit manage it. Required pages are checked per website.
websites.example: Example: shop.example.vn and example.vn can be two websites of two different units.

depth.label: Depth of permissions
depth.title: Role and depth
depth.body: The role says what you may do; the depth says where.
depth.example: Example: a South region manager with depth “Unit and children” can work at every store of the South region.

inherit.label: Effective settings
inherit.title: How do settings pass down?
inherit.body: Once a child unit sets its own value, later changes at the parent no longer reach it. Choose “Use inherited value” to follow the parent again.

incident.label: Data incidents
incident.title: When must an incident be reported?
incident.body: Whenever personal data is leaked, lost or accessed without permission, even before you know how much. Report within the deadline shown on this page, set by the Personal Data Protection Law 2025 (check the original text).

data_requests.label: Data subject requests
data_requests.title: Who is a data subject?
data_requests.body: The person the personal data is about: a buyer, a newsletter subscriber, a member of staff.

plans.label: Plans
plans.title: A plan is data
plans.body: A plan is configuration, not code: changing it needs no new release, and customers on it get the new rights at once. An override for one customer leaves the shared plan unchanged.

placement.label: Data location
placement.title: Shared or own database
placement.body: Shared: many customers in one database, kept apart by tenant_id. Own database: the customer has a database of its own and can choose where it is stored. Moving between the two is a copy job; the customer is read-only for a few minutes.

deliveries.label: Webhook deliveries
deliveries.title: Retries
deliveries.body: A failed delivery is sent again automatically, waiting longer each time, for about two hours. Your receiver must accept the same event twice without doing the work twice.

idempotency.label: Idempotency-Key
idempotency.title: Idempotency-Key
idempotency.body: A key the client sends with a write command. Sending again with the same key returns the first result instead of creating an order or charging twice. Agents retry often, so they always need it.

agent_keys.label: API keys
agent_keys.title: Choosing permissions
agent_keys.body: Give each program or agent its own key with the fewest permissions it needs; add more later if a call is refused. Revoke a key as soon as it may have leaked.

saved_views.title: Save views for filters you use often.
saved_views.body: Choose filters, then press “Save as view” to reopen them in one click next time.
